I added `slugify(title)` to `src/text.ts`, and all 7 tests pass: the 2 existing ones and 5 new ones. I ran `npm test` and got 7 pass, 0 fail.

I wrote the tests first and ran them before the implementation. They failed because `slugify` wasn't exported yet, which is the failure I expected.

The function strips diacritics, lowercases, turns each run of characters outside `a-z` and `0-9` into a single `-`, and trims leading and trailing dashes. It uses no new dependencies, and `capitalize` and `truncate` are unchanged.

The new tests are in `test/text.test.ts`. They cover:
- both examples from the request
- `Crème Brûlée` → `creme-brulee`
- inputs with no letters or digits, which return `""`
- digits being kept

I haven't committed anything.
